en.headline: Tsuen Wan's long-shuttered Ting Tai shop opens briefly for kitchenware sale
en.dek: The ground-floor unit on Sha Tsui Road linked to a 1949-era milk-tea brand held a two-hour pop-up sale of enamel pots and pans on Thursday afternoon.
body: A ground-floor shopfront on Sha Tsui Road in Tsuen Wan that had stayed shuttered for years opened its iron gate on Thursday afternoon for a short warehouse-style sale of kitchenware.

The unit at Tai Shing Building carries a large retro sign reading Ting Tai. Passers-by and social-media users photographed baskets and tables holding lidded cooking pots in green and cream with wooden handles, frying pans and ice buckets, with some items priced at HK$50.

Long-time residents said they had walked past the closed frontage for years and assumed it was empty. The brand is associated with Rings Brand, a Hong Kong company dating to 1949 that became known for aluminium teapots used to brew local-style milk tea; its production later moved to Nanhai in Guangdong while the Tsuen Wan address remained a base.

The brief opening, from noon to about 2.30pm, drew comments from office workers who missed the window and from collectors who still look for the three-rings motif on traditional tea kettles. Sha Tsui Road once formed part of a denser industrial district.

zh.headline: 荃灣長年關閉的鼎泰店舖周四短暫開放廚具特賣
zh.dek: 沙咀道地下舖位與 1949 年港式奶茶品牌相關，周四下午舉行兩小時倉庫式特賣，出售瑠瑪鍋和平底鑀。
body: 荃灣沙咀道一間長年鐵閘緊閉的地下店舖，周四下午短暫開啟，舉行倉庫式廚具特賣。
該舖位於大成樓，外牆掛有大型復古招牌「鼎泰」。途人及社交平台用戶拍攝到籃子和摺櫛上攞放綠色及米色有蓋烹飪鍋、木柄平底鑀及冰桶，部分標價 50 港元。
附近長期居民表示，多年來走過這間關閉的店舖，以為已經空置。鼎泰與 1949 年創立的 Rings Brand 有關，該品牌以鋁製茶壺沖港式奶茶聞名，生產線其後北移廣東南海，荃灣地址仍為業務據點。
是次開放由中午至約下午 2 時半，有上班族錯過時段，亦有收藏家仍尋找傳統茶壺上的三環標誌。沙咀道一帶昔日屬較密集的工業區。
